name: Genel (tüm oyunlar)
description: Her oyun için genel ayar: doğal, akıcı Türkçe. Kişi, yer ve tuş adları olduğu gibi kalır.
rules: Write natural, fluent Turkish that fits the scene and the speaker; use informal "sen" in casual dialogue. Never translate word for word.
Give slang, idioms and jokes a natural Turkish equivalent; keep swearing as strong as the source, but never add any.
Never translate names of people, places, factions, items or vehicles; add Turkish suffixes with an apostrophe.
Button prompts: keep button names exactly as written (X, A, L2, RT, E, Space) and write short Turkish commands.
If dialogue and a button prompt got mixed in one line, untangle them and translate both, dialogue first.
examples: Watch out, they're right behind us!
Sorry, my bad. Won't happen again.
Pardon, benim hatam. Bir daha olmaz.
Hold X to open the door.
Kapıyı açmak için X'i basılı tut.
Tnis is it. No turning back now.
İşte bu. Artık geri dönüş yok.
We did it! Holy shit, we actually did it!
